title: Blank Message
text: Create blank ROS 2 message using specified message type, 1 output, {Message type} sets ROS 2 message type; {Class} and {Sample time} sets the interval between outputs. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Class
params.values: Class of ROS 2 message Message (default) | Service Request | Service Response | Action Goal | Action Feedback | Action Result

params.name: Message type
params.values: ROS 2 message type ’geometry_msgs/Point’ (default) | character vector | dialog box selection

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Interval between outputs Inf (default) | positive numeric scalar
